evidence_items.explanation: The enacted INFORM provisions require online marketplaces to collect and verify seller information, make disclosures, protect collected data, and provide reporting mechanisms, with FTC enforcement. These are concrete congressional constraints on technology platforms, though limited to marketplace activity.
